latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of feishu-mcp-remote, providing remote Feishu MCP service invocation via HTTP API.

- Enables integration with Feishu cloud docs, user directory, and file access using MCP official endpoints.
- Supports both User Access Token (UAT) and Tenant Access Token (TAT) authentication modes.
- Includes out-of-the-box Python usage examples and a comprehensive FeishuMCPClient class for easy integration.
- Allows rapid tool invocation (search users, manage docs, fetch files, etc.) without local deployment.
- Clearly documents supported MCP tools, required permissions, and step-by-step integration workflow.
